Class IOURingQueryHdr

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<IOURingQueryHdr>
org.lwjgl.system.linux.liburing.IOURingQueryHdr
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
@NativeType("struct io_uring_query_hdr") public class IOURingQueryHdr extends Struct<IOURingQueryHdr> implements NativeResource
struct io_uring_query_hdr {
    __u64 next_entry;
    __u64 query_data;
    __u32 query_op;
    __u32 size;
    __s32 result;
    __u32 __resv[3];
}
